data.one_liner: Formats nullable DateTime into human‑friendly relative or absolute timestamps.
data.what_it_does: Provides an extension that converts a DateTime? into a readable string like "Just now", "5m ago" or a formatted date when the value is older. It intelligently switches between relative and absolute representations and supports custom locales, time patterns, and future dates.
use_when: Showing feed items where recent dates should be relative and older dates absolute
avoid_when: When exact timestamps are required without any relative wording
High‑frequency updates where formatting overhead matters
strengths: Smart switching between relative and absolute formats
Supports both past and future dates
weaknesses: Relies on intl package, increasing bundle size
Limited built‑in locale support, requires manual configuration for others
